title: app-1 Can Reach Its Database and Nothing Else
symptom: app-1 was moved to a new rack last night and someone redid its network settings by hand to get it back online quickly. It talks to db-1 fine, but calls to the API and package downloads all fail.

goals.description: app-1's default route uses the real gateway

evidence.description: that the next hop doesn't answer

options: The API and the mirror are both down
The default route pointed at 10.0.1.254, an address with nothing behind it, so ARP for the next hop failed for everything off the local subnet
A firewall rule blocked outbound traffic

debrief: Reaching db-1 but nothing beyond the subnet points straight at the default route, because only off-subnet traffic uses it. 'ip route' showed the gateway as 10.0.1.254, and 'ip neigh' showed ARP for it FAILED: nothing on the wire owns that address. That's also why the errors said 'No route to host' and ping said 'Destination Host Unreachable' from app-1's own address, rather than timing out somewhere far away. The persisted netplan file had the right gateway all along; the by-hand fix just mistyped it. 'ip route replace' fixes it now; the lasting fix is making sure the runtime matches the persisted config (netplan apply), so the next reboot doesn't bring back either version of the mistake.
